title: Iowa AI Laws

reading.body:
Iowa's only AI-related law governs health insurance prior authorization, not AI development, data centers, or compute.

The pattern is narrow and sectoral. HF2635 regulates health carriers and utilization review organizations, and its AI provision is a prohibition: artificial intelligence cannot be the sole basis to deny, delay, or downgrade a medical necessity prior authorization. The law also sets audit and peer review timelines, exempts certain cancer screenings and emergency conditions from prior authorization, updates certificate of need thresholds, and provides enforcement through the insurance commissioner. It passed on 2026-05-13 and takes effect 07/01/2026.

For AI specifically, this is a decision-accountability rule rather than a capability rule. It constrains how an automated output may be used in an adverse coverage decision, which means it touches the deployment of AI in an administrative process, not the construction of the systems or the power they draw. Nothing in this data connects Iowa's law to data center siting, electricity demand, or the physical buildout of compute.

What the data does not cover is the rest of Iowa's legislative activity. It records one law this site judged relevant to AI, read from enrolled text, and it says nothing about bills that failed, provisions in other subject areas, or federal rules that also apply to Iowa carriers. A single law is a thin basis for describing Iowa's posture, and the count should be read as a floor set by this site's inclusion criteria, not as a measure of the state's total regulation of AI.

Iowa has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Iowa

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • HF2635: A bill for an act relating to health carriers standards of conduct; utilization review organizations, artificial intelligence, audits, and prior authorizations; certificate of need processes; and including applicability provisions. (Formerly HF 2438.) Effective date: 07/01/2026. passed 2026-05-13

    This Iowa law regulates health carriers and utilization review organizations in prior authorization, audits, artificial intelligence use, and provider standards of conduct. It prohibits using artificial intelligence as the sole basis to deny, delay, or downgrade medical necessity prior authorizations, sets audit and peer review timelines, and exempts certain cancer screenings and emergency conditions from prior authorization. It also updates certificate of need thresholds and exemptions and provides enforcement through the insurance commissioner.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Iowa. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
